item.content:encoded:
Also I am sure I have a green light. I got it by user DarknessAwaits.

DarknessAwaits does not qualify to give greenlights, per the Ideas Critique forum required reading criteria.

Also, reviewers will be very clear when they are giving a greenlight, often with bold text or colored text. There is no mention of them giving a greenlight in their posts: http://www.scpwiki.com/forum/t-13942203/book-of-the-undead

item.title: Re: critique
item.content:encoded:
Can somebody tell me what I had done wrong? I would like to improve SCP but I have no clue what I did wrong

Reviewers prefer to give in-depth critique before a mainsite post, since then they don't have the pressure of the deletion timer. Ideally you should have asked for feedback on the draft in the forums and/or IRC chatrooms.

since I got a green light on critique

Looking through your forum history, I don't see any greenlights. From whom and where did you receive the greenlight? (Also, note that you need two greenlights to use the draft critique forum. A greenlight doesn't mean your draft is automatically mainsite-ready.)
